narration_text:
Three Articles of Law. Liu Bang won the people of Guanzhong with three rules. In 206 BCE, he entered Xianyang.
With the Qin dynasty fallen, the people feared not a new ruler, but more suffering under a different ruler.
Rather than plundering immediately, Liu Bang summoned the elders of Guanzhong and announced:
Those who kill shall die; injury and theft shall be punished; all other Qin laws shall be abolished.
Murder was punishable by death, injury and theft by law, and the other harsh Qin laws were abolished.
Historical records say the Qin people rejoiced, bringing cattle, sheep, wine, and food to reward the Han army.
That is how the Three Articles of Law came to be.
